diagnostics.message: Complexity and Halstead metrics are unavailable. The graph reports explicit static calls and values in definitions and laws; dynamic calls, datatype declarations, constructors, foreign implementation paths, and desugared operations are omitted.

asked.said: Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect fuel-bounded recursive traversals in this Bend 2 declaration. When a result promises complete parsing, traversal, construction, or search, exhausting Nat fuel before the input is consumed is an explicit failure or partial result, or a stated bound covers every recursive step. Silently substituting an empty tree, missing node, truncated token stream, or successful partial parse breaks this rule. For a split n/2 and n-n/2, the larger child and the leaf step count toward the depth bound. An intentionally bounded approximation with explicit partial status is allowed. If no such traversal exists, this rule holds.

Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect uses of Bend 2 arrays, handles, borrows, and stored closures. A borrowed value is not retained in a returned closure, data structure, or deferred task past the owning value's lifetime. Consumed affine File, Socket, Chan, Array, or closure values are not reused or made reusable merely by adding Data or +. Read-only borrowed inputs may be shared between synchronous fork/join branches when the owner stays alive until they join. Explicit owned Data copies are allowed. Report only a visible escape or reuse, not the mere presence of a borrow, a closure, or parallel code. If none exist, this rule holds.

Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect large-input traversals visibly called from a Bend 2 GPU bang in this file, or explicitly documented as device-reachable. A traversal does not retain one non-tail continuation per list element or nest append chains proportional to an unbounded input without an explicit practical bound or stack-safe representation. Termination fuel by itself does not establish a safe machine-stack bound. Tail-recursive loops and balanced bounded-depth trees are allowed. Name the retained continuation and the input controlling depth. Do not infer unseen GPU reachability or flag recursion alone. If no such traversal is visible, this rule holds.

Judge the parsed target declaration, using supplied helpers to establish its behavior. Do not flag an unrelated declaration merely present in context. Inspect repeated pure whole-input summaries inside a traversal. An unchanged list or tree is not fully walked to compute the same length, sum, hash, or summary for every element of another traversal. Compute that invariant once and carry its result when the helper visibly visits the whole input. A changing suffix, a constant-time metadata lookup, distinct disjoint inputs, and an explicitly fixed small bound are allowed. Require both the unchanged data flow and the repeated linear helper body or known Base List.length; do not guess costs or equate recursion itself with wasted work. If absent, this rule holds.
